verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence is a one-line llama.com tagline, "Multi-agent coding in your terminal," plus documented function calling and agent-optimized inference. Weights are also offered in Hugging Face transformers format. There is no documentation of official skills, plugins, or SDK integrations with named coding agents or agent frameworks, so this is minimal, glancing support. missing for 10: documented official integrations with specific coding agents (skills/plugins), first-class SDK support in agent frameworks, setup docs for agent use, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the model into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, official integrations — skills, plugins, or first-class SDK support

citations.quote: Llama 3.1 provides significant new features, including function calling and agent-optimized inference
In this organization, you can find models in both the original Meta format as well as the Hugging Face transformers format.
